<div class="card-body">
'''Luke's X-34 Landspeeder''' is a [[Light]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Transport Vehicle]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ルークのX-34ランドスピーダー</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">乗客を3名まで乗せられる。ルークが乗っていればコスト0で移動できる。また、戦闘やフォース消耗が移動範囲で起きた場合、リアクションとしてそこへ移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-149o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">スカイウォーカーの所有するソロスーブ社製開放型スピーダーの代表種。最高時速250ｋｍ。反重力駆動で、移動中も停止中も地面から1メートル浮かんでいる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Luke's X-34 Landspeeder.

'''Card text:''' May carry 3 passengers. Moves for 0 if Luke is aboard. May move as a react to a battle or Force drain within range.

'''Lore:''' Skywalker's open SoroSuub speeder. Top speed 250 km/h. Repulsorlift keeps it a meter off the ground, moving or still.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Luke's X-34 Landspeeder]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
